organization: Columbia University (Will group; Holman, Sun, Seo, Will et al.)
notes: A mid-infrared platform based on strontium tweezer arrays. Demonstrates high-fidelity single-atom preparation and resolved-sideband cooling using mid-IR transitions, enabling collective-emission and dipolar many-body physics with flexible atomic arrangements. RELEVANCE 2/5: new species/transition for neutral-atom many-body physics; substrate-level interest for the Rydberg/neutral-atom MERA family, not a logical-qubit or fidelity-record milestone. Does not change physics anchors.
